treatment.sourceFiles: Downloaded JPEGs unchanged. Browser downsamples each full map to 1024x512. No geography generation or future edits.
treatment.projection: Shared SphericalSurface atlas mapping, 192px sphere; fixed central longitudes 20E, 100W and 110E.
treatment.clouds: Grayscale brightness × 0.85 as illustrative white cloud opacity; no height or weather simulation.
treatment.lighting: Shared RockBodyPainter mask, hard-light blend, light direction (-400,-160), matching Practice blend.
treatment.night: Warm emission derived from max(red,green) - 0.45*blue - 12, divided by 65 and clamped. Suppressed by surface normal dot light and attenuated by cloud cover. Artistic extraction, not measured radiance.
treatment.atmosphere: B only: blue aerial perspective increases at grazing angles; outer limb fades over 5.5% of body radius on the lit side; small warm twilight contribution. Analytic rendering, not generated texture or a physical scattering calculation.
treatment.fixtures: Earth radius42u; Mercury27u and Venus40.327526u. Main3.2px/u; neighbours0.7 and0.4px/u; other longitudes1.8px/u. Static no simulation or orbit; no accepted Earth size, mass, motion or placement.
